title: Operation Analyst - Presales Operation
description:
We have an urgent requirement for an Operations Analyst - Presales Operations. Please share suitable profiles with relevant experience in presales support, CRM operations, and business process improvement. Job Details Employment Type: Full-Time Employment (FTE) on Cloud Analogy payroll. Work Location: Pan-India - Noida, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Chennai. Technical Skill Requirements Presales Operations: Experience in operational support, business analysis, or process support within sales, presales, CRM, quotation, approvals, or sales enablement environments. Process Understanding: Knowledge of quotation creation, product configuration, pricing support, approvals, and handover to order management. Service and Issue Management: Experience handling service requests, incidents, user queries, troubleshooting, and escalations. Tools: Hands-on exposure to ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or comparable platforms. Reporting and Analysis: Ability to analyse support tickets, SLA performance, issue trends, backlog status, operational KPIs, and process bottlenecks. Documentation: Experience maintaining operational procedures, user guidance, known-error documentation, and support processes. Communication: Strong coordination skills with business stakeholders, Product Owners, IT teams, and end users. Good-to-Have Skills: CRM, CPQ, approval tools, ERP integrations, or reporting dashboards. ITIL, service management, business analysis, Lean, or process improvement knowledge. Experience coordinating testing, validation, releases, and business readiness activities. Profile Submission Format Please share matching candidate profiles in the following matrix: Name Mobile No. Official Email ID Total Exp. Relevant Experience Relevant Tools / Platforms Current Organization Notice Period / LWD Current Location Please share technically screened profiles with relevant presales operations, business process support, or CRM operations experience.
